source.description: Maintained Wow Together raid definitions, transcribed from the existing InstanceAccess.lua list and the owner's supplied raid brief; these facts are names, level bands, opening notes, and the existing Onyxia zone label only.
limitations: This is first-party project data, not a third-party addon extract.
No entrance coordinates are supplied. The imported CMaNGOS priors contain no outdoor entrance coordinate for Onyxia's Lair.
The Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit location hints remain unknown; do not infer them from the raid names.
Quest IDs and quest item drops are intentionally omitted in this data round.
